prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-16, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-16):
| Return 3m            | +41.3% |
| Return 1m            | +8.2% |
| Return 1w            | +4.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 87% |
| 21d realized vol     | 44% |
| Last close           | 39.92 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has strong recent momentum with 3-month gains of 41%, but the 63-day range position at 87% suggests it’s near the upper end of its range, indicating potential near-term resistance and risk of mean reversion. With elevated but not extreme volatility (21-day realized vol ~44%), a cautious stance is warranted over the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: HOLD
